page.layout: One column of running text; a marginal note at the right, beside the line "Tetra-". Below the text: the signature at the left and the catchword at the right.

main_text.p: exacerbationibus neutrum adhiberi coue- nit corpore quantumuis probè expurgato. Tunc enim non solum dolores intenderet, sed etiam multò maiorem fluxione, quàm antea accerferet. Igitur alterutrum, quietis tempore, corpori applicandum est. Quó-niam autem modo articulos inurere oportet, docet Aëtius, Sermone quarto: TetraCap.25.[?]-tertio. Infestatis podagra (inquit) loci circa utrunq; talum (si uterque pes morbo laboret) foris & intus inurendi sunt, cauterijs iuxta magnas ibidem sitas uenas admotis, paulò altius supra talorum locum. Inuren-dus item locus inter magnum pedis digi-tum, & eum qui proximus est, medius, ubi sane magis uenę conspiciuntur tumefactę, praesertim ex eis maximae. Quibusdam autem & articulos ipsos perurere expedit, quum submucidi ualde conspicui sunt, priusquam duritiez[?] admodum tophorum in eis generetur. Sciendum tamen (quemadmodum inquit Rufus) quòd in submucidorum articulorum perustione ulcera ægrè sanabilia oriuntur. Verum ubi cicatrices coaluerint, maximum roburipsis articulis praebent, ita ut non amplius ad suscipiendum influentia excrementa sint apti.

page.notes: The marginal reference "Cap.25." is partly doubtful (the final figure). "duritiez" is doubtful: the last letters may be a ligature or a different word. "roburipsis" and "submucidi" are printed joined or as printed; left as they stand. "Tetra-" with "tertio" on the next line is a line-end break that keeps its hyphen.
